versions.subject: feat: more updates
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - OriginalFileName:
        - 'net.exe'
        - 'net1.exe'
    - Image|endswith:
        - '\net.exe'
        - '\net1.exe'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains: ' stop '
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: OriginalFileName IN ("net.exe", "net1.exe") OR Image IN ("*\\net.exe", "*\\net1.exe") CommandLine="* stop *"
